TLDR.value: Efficient, sparse finetuning of LoRA matrices using expander masks.

abstract.value: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning aims to reduce the computational cost of adapting foundational models to downstream tasks. Low-rank matrix based adaptation (LoRA) techniques are popular for this purpose. We propose XoRA, an efficient fine-tuning scheme, which sparsifies the low-rank matrices even further using expander masks. The mask is generated using extremal expander graphs (Ramanujan graphs) to maintain high edge connectivity even at a very high sparsity. Experimental results demonstrate that this method has comparable performance with the LoRA fine-tuning method while retaining much fewer number of parameters.
